title: Users & roles
subtitle: Staff accounts, their role, branches and cash limit.

form.phoneHelp: Used to sign in on the staff app. 11 digits, starts with 01.
form.usernameHelp: Optional. Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash.

roleHelp.super_admin: Everything in every branch, including settings and permissions.
roleHelp.field_staff: Uses the staff app in one branch.
roleHelp.viewer: Read-only access to the branches listed below.

form.erpIdHelp: Links the account to the ERP staff record. Optional.
form.cashLimitHelp: Leave empty to use the branch default.
form.saveDesc: Changed: {{fields}}. The audit log records your reason.

errors.phone: Enter an 11-digit mobile number starting with 01.
errors.oneBranch: Field staff work in exactly one branch.

tempBody: Give this password to {{name}} privately. It is shown only once; they must change it at first sign-in.

drawer.resetDesc: Their current password stops working and they will be signed out of every device.
drawer.deactivateDesc: They are signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in. Their records stay. Hand over their customers and collect their cash first.
